title: Perfume as a bag charm
what: Small bottles designed to hang from a bag, so the scent is carried and seen like an accessory.
note: CYKLAR sells a silicone sleeve for its oil cap; WHIPPED and Milky Mane sell keyring and 20 ml bag sizes. Le Falcone's Bonita bottles go further: the bottle itself is shaped like a small handbag.

title: Hair perfumes that also care
what: Light, low-alcohol mists for hair, often with keratin or oils for shine.
note: WHIPPED Peach Pear adds low-molecule keratin; Tamburins has a hair perfume line. It has reached the drugstore: Herbal Essences sells 95 ml 'up to 48 hour' hair mists (lavender-vanilla-powder, rose-lily-apple, coconut-jasmine), Crémerie's gourmand hair mists double as heat protectant, and Bouf combines hair gloss with perfume in one bottle.

title: Budget twins of luxury perfumes
what: Creators pair cheap mists or Gulf brands with the luxury perfumes they resemble.
note: See the budget twins list. These are opinions, so smell before buying.

title: Sample cards and tiny jars
what: Small makers send tiny sample jars or vials attached to a printed card that doubles as a business card or gift.
note: Many indies include a matching sample with each bottle so you can test before opening the full size. Brands are also selling 7 ml minis in gift tins (Dime Beauty's Stay Awhile, a toasted-pistachio gourmand, is one).

title: Layering sets
what: Brands design scents to be worn on top of each other and sell them in numbered or paired sets.
note: KAYALI numbers each scent; CYKLAR and Michael Malul sell layering sets; Tamburins sells balms to wear under spray. Creators pair cheap Gulf perfumes for creamy white florals, e.g. Lattafa Petra with Teriaq Intense, Fakhar Rose with Yara, Her Confession or Gharam with Angham, and Khadlaj Nafais Sharq with Cream Velvet. Another creator pair: Billie Eilish Eilish with Al Rehab Soft. More budget pairs from an Indian creator: Al Rehab Choco Musk with EM5 La Vanilla, and Sharon Beauty Vanilla Muse with Skinn Caramel Charm.

title: Buy big, split with friends
what: Brands sell extra-large bottles with empty minis included so a group can share one purchase.
note: Cozy's XL khamreya comes with six empty bottles, bringing the cost per share right down.

title: Products that don't exist (yet)
what: Creators post AI-made images and dream flankers of collections brands never released, and some brand pages post AI imagery too.
note: Check the brand's own site before hunting for something you saw on social media. Wish it existed? Use 'Wish it existed?' in the Find tab to find real scents close to it, or a perfumer who can make it.
